top_signals.title: Roundhill’s Pettit Discusses Jensen Huang’s Return
top_signals.summary:
Drew Pettit, chief investment strategist at Roundhill Investments, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on “Bloomberg ETF IQ.” They discuss the shocking return of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia.

 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
